description:
## 1.0.0 (2026-11-01)

### ✨ New Features

* Hide sponsored content, Disable tracking and Disable Play license check patches for bol ([4aaf469](https://github.com/wouter075/bol-patches/commit/4aaf469601e6d30e87ba6cc62957a9948bb245dd))

patches.name: Disable Play license check
patches.description: Required for a patched (re-signed) app: skips the Google Play license check that would otherwise close the app.

patches.name: Disable tracking
patches.description: Disables analytics and tracking: RudderStack, AppsFlyer, Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Firebase Performance, Sentry, Airship analytics and the advertising id. Push notifications keep working.

patches.name: Hide sponsored content
patches.description: Removes sponsored products from search results, the sponsored and advertisement sections on product pages, and the display ad banners on the home, search and category pages.
